originalTitle: U.S. stock futures edge high after bruising Oct; earnings, elections in focus
summary: Investing.com-- U.S. stock index futures rose on Sunday evening, heralding some recovery on Wall Street after doubts over artificial intelligence spending sparked deep losses in technology valuations in October.
content:
Investing.com-- U.S. stock index futures rose on Sunday evening, heralding some recovery on Wall Street after doubts over artificial intelligence spending sparked deep losses in technology valuations in October.

Still guessing which stocks will beat the market? Our AI portfolio updates monthly and is outperforming the S&P 500 by 118%. See this month's list »

Focus is now squarely on more key earnings due this week, with Apple set to report on Monday while the midterm elections are scheduled for Tuesday.

S&P 500 Futures rose 0.2% to 7,630.75 points, Nasdaq 100 Futures rose 0.36% to 28,644.0 points, and Dow Jones Futures rose 0.17% to 52,016.0 points by 18:18 ET (23:18 GMT).

Futures firmed after a deeply negative Friday session on Wall Street, which capped off a month of pronounced tech-driven losses in U.S. markets.

The NASDAQ Composite slid more than 5% in October, while the S&P 500 shed 0.9%. Flows out of tech and into more defensive sectors saw the Dow Jones Industrial Average add 1.7% in October.

Chipmakers and AI-exposed names were the worst performers, as a swathe of middling megacap tech earnings sparked increased questions over whether the hundreds of billions of dollars invested in the technology will bring adequate returns.

Unsure what to buy ahead of earnings? Our AI's recent pre-earnings calls delivered gains of +77% to +118% after results dropped. See this month's earnings picks »

Several more major tech companies are set to report this week, with prints from iPhone maker Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) and data firm Palantir Technologies Inc (NASDAQ:PLTR) due on Monday.

Hedge fund Berkshire Hathaway Inc (NYSE:BRKa) is also set to report on Monday, while chipmaker Advanced Micro Devices Inc (NASDAQ:AMD) will report on Tuesday.

The U.S. midterm elections are also on tap this week, and are broadly expected to set the tone for legislative policy over the remainder of President Donald Trump's second term.

Trump and the Republican party face a challenging backdrop going into the elections, amid growing voter discontent over high gasoline prices and a prolonged war with Iran.

A recent Reuters/IPSOS poll showed Trump's approval at a record-low 31%. All 435 seats in the House of Representatives, along with 35 Senate seats are on the ballot.

A Democrat majority in both levels of Congress presents a major hurdle to Trump and the Republicans in enacting more policies. A split Congress could also push the White House into relying more on executive measures for policy, which could keep uncertainty high for the remainder of Trump's term.

chineseTitle: 美国股指期货在 10 月份遭遇重创后小幅走高；盈利、选举成为焦点
chineseSummary: Investing.com——美国股指期货周日晚间上涨，预示着华尔街在对人工智能支出的疑虑导致 10 月份科技股估值大幅下跌后出现一定程度的复苏。
chineseContent:
Investing.com——美国股指期货周日晚间上涨，预示着华尔街在对人工智能支出的疑虑导致 10 月份科技股估值大幅下跌后出现一定程度的复苏。

还在猜测哪些股票会跑赢大盘？我们的人工智能投资组合每月更新一次，表现优于标准普尔 500 指数 118%。查看本月列表 »

现在的焦点完全集中在本周即将发布的更多关键财报上，苹果公司将于周一发布报告，而中期选举定于周二举行。

截至东部时间 18:18（格林威治标准时间 23:18），标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 0.2%，至 7,630.75 点，纳斯达克 100 期货上涨 0.36%，至 28,644.0 点，道琼斯期货上涨 0.17%，至 52,016.0 点。

周五华尔街股市大幅下跌后，期货走强，结束了美国市场由科技驱动的一个月明显下跌。

纳斯达克综合指数 10 月份下跌超过 5%，标准普尔 500 指数下跌 0.9%。资金从科技股流出并流入更具防御性的板块，导致道琼斯工业平均指数 10 月份上涨 1.7%。

芯片制造商和人工智能领域的公司表现最差，大量中等规模的大型科技公司的盈利引发了越来越多的质疑，即投资于该技术的数千亿美元是否会带来足够的回报。

不确定在盈利之前买什么？在业绩下滑后，我们的 AI 最近的财报前电话会议带来了 +77% 至 +118% 的涨幅。查看本月收益精选 »

更多主要科技公司将于本周公布报告，其中 iPhone 制造商苹果公司 (NASDAQ:AAPL) 和数据公司 Palantir Technologies Inc (NASDAQ:PLTR) 将于周一公布报告。

对冲基金伯克希尔哈撒韦公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BRKa）也将于周一发布报告，而芯片制造商Advanced Micro Devices Inc（纳斯达克股票代码：AMD）将于周二发布报告。

美国中期选举也将于本周举行，人们普遍预计将为唐纳德·特朗普总统第二任期剩余时间的立法政策定下基调。

特朗普和共和党在选举中面临着充满挑战的背景，选民对高油价和与伊朗旷日持久的战争的不满情绪日益高涨。

路透社/益普索最近的一项民意调查显示，特朗普的支持率创下历史新低31%。众议院全部 435 个席位以及参议院 35 个席位均已进入投票。

民主党在国会两级均占多数，这对特朗普和共和党制定更多政策构成了重大障碍。国会分裂还可能促使白宫更多地依赖行政措施来制定政策，这可能会使特朗普剩余任期的不确定性保持在较高水平。
